title: Fix duplicate-row bug in WNBA ETL merge() pattern
description: Five WNBA ETLs use db.merge(Obj(...)) without setting the primary key id, which always INSERTs rather than upserts. Affected: update_team_roster, update_team_offense_stats, update_team_defense_stats, update_injury_status, today_active_players. Tables with unique constraints (offense/defense_stats, injury_status, today_active_players) now hard-fail on second run; team_roster silently duplicates rows. Discovered during Phase 2 T14 smoke 2026-05-22. Convert all five to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (Postgres native upsert) and add a UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) constraint to pred_wnba_team_roster. Manual dedupe SQL applied to recover team_roster on 2026-05-22.
close_reason: Converted five WNBA ETLs to Postgres ON CONFLICT upserts; added UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) on pred_wnba_team_roster

Add ETL from NFL stats sources (or Sleeper stats) and Celery/scheduler job. Acceptance: non-zero player_analytics rows for current season; start/sit returns projections when user has connected league.
close_reason: player_analytics ETL from nflverse + Celery beat Tuesday job

title: Replace mock/random fantasy projections
description: FantasyPipeline.generate_fantasy_projections uses random.uniform; /api/fantasy/projections uses mock_games; FantasyAnalyticsService waiver ownership uses np.random placeholder. Replace with player_analytics + matchup-aware model (reuse MLB/WNBA patterns where sensible). Acceptance: projections deterministic given inputs; no random.* in production fantasy paths.
close_reason: P1/P2 fantasy completion: API routes, v1 analytics alignment, deterministic projections, matchups/trending UI, pytest + Playwright fixtures

title: Fix start/sit team resolution for all users
description: get_start_sit_recommendations hardcodes owner match on 'byetz' and falls back to first team; only processes first league. Resolve user team via connected Sleeper user_id vs roster owner_id. Support league selector + all connected leagues. Acceptance: connected non-byetz users get correct roster recommendations.
close_reason: Start/sit resolves team via platform_user_id=owner_id; all leagues + league_id filter; no byetz fallback

title: Wire Trade Analyzer to real league rules
description: loadLeagueForAnalysis sets mock league rules and skips API. Use GET /api/fantasy/leagues/{id}/rules (already implemented) when opening Trade Analyzer. Remove mock fallback except explicit dev flag. Acceptance: trade grades reflect actual league scoring/roster settings.
close_reason: Trade Analyzer loads real league rules via API, passes leagueRules to component, removes hardcoded platform league ID, uses scoring/roster context in analysis UI

title: Complete matchups + trending players UI
description: Matchups state exists but no handler/UI; trendingPlayers always []. Add matchups endpoint + league card action; wire getTrendingPlayers to waiver trending API or Sleeper trending. Acceptance: user can view weekly matchups and trending adds from fantasy page.
close_reason: P1/P2 fantasy completion: API routes, v1 analytics alignment, deterministic projections, matchups/trending UI, pytest + Playwright fixtures

title: Extract fantasy routes from main.py into routers
description: ~4000 lines of fantasy endpoints live inline in main.py alongside fantasy_analytics router. Move to app/api/fantasy/*.py modules (connect, recommendations, trade-analyzer, legacy analytics). Acceptance: main.py only includes routers; behavior unchanged.
close_reason: Routes extracted to app/api/fantasy/*; main.py registers fantasy_router only.

title: NBA totals: STAR_PLAYER_IMPACTS misses accented roster names and may be oversized
description: calculate_injury_impact matches player_name.lower() against plain-ASCII keys, so ESPN names with diacritics (Nikola Jokić, Luka Dončić) likely never match. Fixing the match alone would add more negative adjustments; the PR #158 backtest showed injuries contributed ~1.8 pts of under-bias. Fix name matching (normalize_player_name on both sides) together with re-sizing impacts against graded games with a star out.

title: NHL goalie predictions: add unique (game_date, team_id) index; handle matinee games before 16:45 ET
close_reason: Unique index and matinee refresh shipped in #191

title: Boards show picks from withheld markets (NBA Best edges, NFL endpoint, NHL edge)
description: NBA strips only steals/blocks and never clears edge; NFL endpoint never calls the withholding helper; frontend rebuilds a spread side; kickers shown. See docs/projection-review-2026-11-17.md (PR #189), item A5-A7.

title: NBA spread/win-prob projector (backport from WNBA)
description: After WNBA Plan A ships, port the WNBA Elo+pace spread/win-prob projector to NBA. NBA currently has only a totals_projector and no own spread/win-prob model. Lives in app/services/etl/nba/spread_projector.py mirroring the WNBA file.

title: Long manual ETL runs re-run 24h later after a worker kill (visibility_timeout)
description: Same task id STARTED twice ~24h apart: run_nba_update_pipeline 6680ffab (2026-11-07 22:51Z, 11-08 22:52Z) and 4b87b9b0 (11-10 21:37Z, 11-11 21:37Z). acks_late + visibility_timeout 86400: a run killed mid-way by a deploy is redelivered a day later and occupies the concurrency-1 worker for ~70 min at an arbitrary time. Consider expires on admin enqueues of long orchestrators. Found during YetAI-kij.

title: Give non-NBA-prop markets a consensus price so they can be auto-picked
description: Under selection rule ev-v1 only NBA props can be picked. NBA spread/total/moneyline, NFL, NHL, MLB and WNBA candidates carry no multi-book consensus fair probability or probability model. See docs/build-2026-11-18.md.

title: Daily review yardsticks: prob CLV vig offset, MAE on different rows, close capture for all prop markets
description: Prob CLV compares with-vig price to no-vig close; points/threes/steals close is the 17:00 fetch; projection MAE on all rows vs line MAE on lined rows. See docs/projection-review-2026-11-17.md (PR #189), item B2-B3.

title: Phase 1a: live fair-price flags in shadow; decide after 300 flags
description: Per docs/edge-engine-design.md and the pre-committed rule in docs/edge-engine-backtest-2025-26.md (verdict inconclusive: CLV +1.35pp, ROI -3.0%). Test the retail-books-excluding-ESPN-BET hypothesis; consensus-only book list for exchanges; swap fanatics/ballybet for novig/prophetx in PROP_BOOKS.
close_reason: PR #187 merged and deployed 2026-11-15; flagger running on bets-worker. Decision tracked separately.
